morphology.formula: ∅ + dallas → dallas；作专名时通常写作 Dallas
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留为不可拆分专名，不作马来语词缀分析；音标采用所选地名的英语读法。

senses.zh_definition: 达拉斯：美国得克萨斯州的一座城市；此处采用这一常见地名解释。
senses.en_definition: Dallas, a city in Texas, United States; a proper place name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas sebuah bandar di negeri Texas, Amerika Syarikat.
senses.nuances: 输入未给出语境，Dallas 也可能是人名或其他专名，不能确认本次词例一定指这座城市。它不是据现有材料即可确认为官方马来语普通词的词项。以下为地名用例，不代表已验证的高频搭配。城市资料见 [Dallas 市政府](https://dallascityhall.com/government/citysecretary/archives/Pages/Archives_history.aspx)。

dual_scenarios.en: The company delegation will attend a conference in Dallas, Texas, next week.

etymology.historical_story: Dallas illustrates how a familiar place name can retain an uncertain naming history. The city archives report no primary evidence explaining founder John Neely Bryan’s choice. Several possible namesakes have been proposed, but none is securely established. A dictionary should therefore preserve that uncertainty rather than present one attractive story as settled fact. See the [city archives](https://dallascityhall.com/government/citysecretary/archives/Pages/Archives_DallasNameOrigin.aspx).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文地名“达拉斯”联想 Dallas，再单独记住英语读音 /ˈdæləs/；中文译名不等于精确音标。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 地名本身没有敬语差别；正式介绍时写 Dallas, Texas, Amerika Syarikat，可帮助读者明确地点。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 专名首字母大写。谈论出行或新闻时确认所指城市；若 Dallas 是某人的姓名，应保留其姓名拼写，不自动翻译成城市名。
